business_problem: altermAInd needed a database platform that could support fast-moving AI products while preserving governance, GDPR compliance, and strict operational controls in heavily regulated European markets.
solution_summary: altermAInd runs its AI platforms on MongoDB Atlas to balance aggressive innovation with European regulatory controls. Atlas underpins Gravity, the company's AI governance platform, and Nebula, its service-level and compliance-monitoring product, by storing real-time operational and model-interaction data in a schema-flexible cloud database that can adapt as products change. Atlas observability, access controls, and data-governance features help the team keep GDPR, the AI Act, and DORA requirements in view while still supporting AI agents, generative interfaces, and rapid product iteration. Because Atlas is fully managed, altermAInd can focus on shipping compliant AI experiences instead of running infrastructure, and the same platform now supports services for more than 200,000 retail customers and 10,000 businesses across Europe.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas

data_flow: Operational and model-interaction data from Gravity and Nebula flows into MongoDB Atlas, where the schema-flexible store supports real-time governance, service-level monitoring, and AI-agent experiences. Atlas then serves low-latency application access while helping the team enforce access controls and compliance requirements across customers.
